about: Model name to Bedrock client entity and geometry key; model part to the vanilla Bedrock bone it replaces (matched by vanilla geometry, then part names); vanilla Java part pivots (Java model space) and rest rotations in degrees; vanilla Java motion of parts that model expressions may read. A frame (scale, offset in Bedrock units) moves Java model space onto the Bedrock geometry where the Java renderer scales or offsets the model; it is measured from matching vanilla cubes.
